verdict: Ads went dark two days, spiking costs — delivery is restored.
narrative: This period delivered 94 leads at an average cost of $7.40 per lead, a solid 28-day baseline. However, the final days of the week pulled that picture down sharply: ads stopped running on September 12–13, producing zero leads on both days and pushing last week's cost per lead to roughly $37 — a 169% jump against the 28-day average. Delivery has been restored and spend is back in market. You should expect lead volume and cost per lead to normalise in the coming week as full delivery resumes. Separately, several tracking and reporting milestones are overdue, which is limiting our ability to show the full leads-to-patients picture; those are being worked through now as a priority.
